items.question: 武汉力源信息技术股份有限公司组织结构图中，销售部有几个部门构成，其中大客户销售部有几个销售处构成？
items.answer:

items.question: In the organization chart of Wuhan P&S Information Technology Co., Ltd., how many departments make up the Sales Department, and how many sales offices make up the Key Account Sales Department?
items.answer:
The Sales Department consists of 4 departments: International Trade Department, Key Account Sales Department, Channel Sales Department, and Telephone and Network Sales Department; the Key Account Sales Department comprises 6 offices: Beijing Sales Office, Guangzhou Sales Office, Chengdu Sales Office, Wuhan Sales Office, Shenzhen Sales Office, and Zhuhai Sales Office.
引用：[招股说明书2.pdf: 第39页 组织结构图]
